sprint.title: One-Time Consequence-Bearing Conversation Response
sprint.goal: Make the discovery-gated Elin patrol-dispatch response and its declared canonical consequence occur exactly once.
acceptance_criteria: Before the qualifying discovery, the Elin patrol-dispatch response remains unavailable.
The first eligible Elin conversation returns the authored response and applies one canonical patrol-dispatch consequence.
Subsequent Elin conversations do not repeat the response or consequence, including after save/load.
Existing unrelated conversations and nonpersistent player-safe projection behavior remain intact; save version remains 1 and next_sprint remains null.

staging_commands: Official-interpreter preflight through the established workspace procedure
focused_commands: Focused conversation response and affordance tests
Affected discovery, evidence, thread-resolution, relocation, travel, contextual-action, narration-preview, and save/load regressions

governance: No sprint or capability package is currently active or staged.
Use canonical World State history for the declared one-time patrol-dispatch consequence; do not add a generic dialogue-consumption flag or system.
Keep save version 1 and preserve save/load compatibility.
Do not change player-facing contextual-cue wording, parsing, providers, or next_sprint.

closeout.verification_result: Focused response and affordance coverage, affected regressions, and all 38 local deterministic tests passed. No live provider request occurred. Save version remains 1 and next_sprint remains null. The accepted candidate was strict-fast-forward merged into main.
